newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian sugar crush - week to June 21.
newsitem.headline: Australian sugar crush - week to June 21.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush totalled 852,353 tonnes in the week ended June 21, bringing the crush so far this year to 1.28 million tonnes, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.

This is behind the 1.35 million tonnes crushed at the same time last year. CANEGROWERS reported for crushing week three of the 1997 season that average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content was 12.23 percent for the week.
The figures do not include cane crushed in the Ord River region of Western Australia.
